single_change: Freeze all pretrained representation parameters; only head, existing power-anchored channel mixer, and residual gate remain trainable. Same forward function, initialization, total parameter count, dropout mode, loss, LR, epochs, chronological selection, data and scalers as v21.
training_evidence: All three v21 internal selection minima occur at epochs 3/3/1; subsequent fit loss falls while internal selection error rises. Encoder relative L2 drift from the cached pretrain grows from 3.45/3.51/2.05 percent at best to 5.86/6.19/5.89 percent at last. This supports a falsifiable over-adaptation hypothesis, not a proven sole cause.
pretrain_reuse: Exact same-fold v20 cached pretrain recorded by v21; no retraining and no fine-tuned initialization
inner_epoch_selection: Unchanged original-scale MAE early stopping, max20 patience5, including epoch0; no alternative checkpoint selection

outer_gate.if_failed: Retain training-only negative result; no new outer prediction, appended seed, threshold or candidate
outer_gate.if_passed: Evaluate all three exact candidates once, including any harmed fold; no outer-based fallback

claim_scope: Exploratory numerical transfer ablation, not a new Wiki mechanism or independent confirmation
